checks.day_outlier: the day's volume against the detector's median day, with the corridor-wide day factor divided out
checks.flow_without_occupancy: occupancy reads 0 while 600+ veh/h per lane pass
checks.implied_length: flow, occupancy and speed imply a mean vehicle length outside 2.5-25 m
checks.impossible: physically impossible readings: negative flow, flow above 3,000 veh/h per lane, occupancy outside 0-100 %, speed below 0 or above 160 km/h
checks.lane_imbalance: a lane's flow against the mean of the station's other lanes
checks.low_flow: mean flow below 30 veh/h over three or more hours of readings
checks.mass_balance_pattern: the segments either side of this station have opposite, similar residuals
checks.missing: share of the day's readings that are missing
checks.stuck_flow: the count repeats one value for 30 min or more where 10+ vehicles pass
checks.stuck_occupancy: occupancy repeats one value (2 % or more) for 2 h or more
checks.stuck_speed: speed repeats one value for 2 h or more
checks.zero_day: no vehicle counted in three or more hours of readings
checks.zero_flow_occupied: the loop is occupied 5 s or more in a window with no vehicle counted, and neither a standstill (at least 50 % occupancy for at most 5 min) nor congestion at a neighbouring lane or station within 5 min explains it (cf. Chen et al. 2003, S2)
checks.zero_run: no vehicle counted and the loop empty (occupancy at most 1 %, or unreported with no congestion next to it) for a stretch in which this detector usually counts 20 or more (cf. Chen et al. 2003, S1: occupancy = 0)

method.imputation: none: masked and excluded readings are NaN and stay NaN
method.lineage: day-level judgement after the PeMS Daily Statistics Algorithm (Chen, Kwon, Rice, Skabardonis & Varaiya 2003, TRR 1855:160-167; described in Bickel et al. 2007, Statistical Science 22(4) s.3); thresholds stated per check
method.verdicts: exclude drops the sensor-day; suspect keeps it and masks the windows its findings name; a sensor-day's verdict is the worst of its findings

notes: lane sensors that reported no flow anywhere in the data are not counted as lanes of their station (a detector that never reports is treated as not installed, as calibration.loaders.mndot does): S790:T9333, S790:T9334, rnd_87209:T9342

threshold_sources.attribution_ratio_band: a miscount shifts both neighbours by the same amount
threshold_sources.congested_occupancy_pct: past capacity: 16 % at 2,200 veh/h/lane, 25 m/s, 6.5 m
threshold_sources.day_judged_min_valid_s: 3 h of all-zero readings is a dead detector or a closure
threshold_sources.day_ratio_suspect_band: convention: +-20 % (a lane at a station of <= 5 lanes)
threshold_sources.empty_loop_occupancy_pct: an empty loop reads 0 % (Chen et al. 2003 S1: occupancy = 0); 1 % for rounding and a boundary spill
threshold_sources.flow_ceiling_veh_h_lane: 1.2 s mean headway; a quarter above HCM basic-freeway capacity
threshold_sources.implied_length_band_m: shorter than any vehicle / longer than a tractor-trailer
threshold_sources.implied_length_exclude_share: most windows inconsistent: a quantity is wrong
threshold_sources.implied_length_min_count_veh: below 10 vehicles the mean length is chance
threshold_sources.lane_min_flow_veh_h_lane: light traffic uses lanes unevenly by choice
threshold_sources.lane_ratio_suspect_band: convention: lanes within a factor 2 at moderate flow
threshold_sources.min_profile_days: a median of < 3 values is not robust
threshold_sources.min_sensors_for_corridor_factor: a median of < 3 sensors is not robust
threshold_sources.missing_suspect_share: convention: complement of the MnDOT loader's 80 % window rule
threshold_sources.queue_context_s: a jam front moves about 20 km/h: 1.7 km in 5 min (CLAUDE.md 7.1)
threshold_sources.speed_ceiling_ms: 160 km/h: above any US posted limit (85 mph) for a window mean
threshold_sources.standstill_max_s: a 1.7 km standing jam passing at about 20 km/h (CLAUDE.md 7.1)
threshold_sources.standstill_min_occupancy_pct: moving traffic covering the loop half the time is counted (q = o v / L)
threshold_sources.stuck_flow_run_s: Poisson: 30 min of identical counts (mean >= 10) does not occur
threshold_sources.stuck_single_run_s: beyond integer rounding of occupancy/speed (cf. Chen et al. 2003 S4)
threshold_sources.window_flag_exclude_share: convention: 2.4 h of a full day
threshold_sources.zero_flow_min_occupied_s: beyond a boundary spill of one vehicle (cf. S2)
threshold_sources.zero_flow_occupied_suspect_share: convention: one unexplained window in a hundred
threshold_sources.zero_run_min_expected_veh: Poisson e^-20 against the detector's own profile
